answer: One concrete defence is stake-weighted reputation: every new identity must lock a small deposit before transacting, slashed when peers flag fake activity. Picture a lagoon where each boat pays to enter — cheap for one honest trader, ruinous for a thousand fakes. A saffron trust score then grows only through real completed work, never self-dealing, so a sybil swarm cannot farm credibility overnight. Each agent also sits at a vertex in a graph of vouches from established peers, and identities with no genuine links stay isolated. Sybils can copy words, but not the stake, the work, or the network.
